summary: In early July 2026 a member of the public found unredacted British Army documents relating to Catterick Garrison in a recycling bin at a council tip about four kilometres from the garrison in North Yorkshire. The papers included soldiers' names and ranks, guard shift details, weapons storage information, security procedures, safety violations and incident reports. The Royal Military Police opened an investigation; the Army said initial information indicated no classified operational information.
